The '''18th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in film for 1960, were held on March 16, 1961.

==Winners and nominees==
[[File:Burt Lancaster - publicity 1947.JPG|thumb|right|160px|[[Burt Lancaster]] won for ''[[Elmer Gantry]]'']]
[[File:Greer Garson-publicity.JPG|thumb|right|160px|[[Greer Garson]] won for ''[[Sunrise at Campobello]]'']]
[[File:Jack Lemmon - 1968.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Jack Lemmon]] won for ''[[The Apartment]]'']]
[[File:Shirley MacLaine - 1960.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Shirley MacLaine]] won for ''[[The Apartment]]'']]
[[File:Janet Leigh Publicity.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Janet Leigh]] won for ''[[Psycho (1960 film)|Psycho]]'']]
